days.title: Wetlands and Historic Itineraries
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: itinerario de Santa Madrona
stops.detail: The Santa Madrona itinerary skirts the southwest shore of the albufera, and allows for the observation of aquatic birds, as it is very close to the lagoon and has several viewpoints and observatories.

stops.name: itinerario del mirador de Cala Llimpa
stops.detail: The Cala Llimpa viewpoint itinerary covers the southeastern part of the lagoon.

stops.name: playa del Grao
stops.detail: The Sa Gola itinerary covers the Sa Gola canal and the dune area of the Grao beach.

days.title: Ancient Estates and Islands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: isla de Colom
stops.detail: Three areas are distinguished: the island of Colom, the Favarich lighthouse-Morella meadow area, and the lagoon and meadow of the Albufera.

stops.name: Sa Torreta
stops.detail: The albufera has some archaeological remains among which are the vestiges of the Talayotic culture of the Sa Torreta estate; it also includes some of the most important megalithic monuments in Menorca.

stops.name: Camí de Cavalls
stops.detail: Additionally, the park includes part of the ancient Camí de Cavalls ("horse path") that surrounds the island.
